programme.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt S1 Ep17 (海洋前物业猎 S1 Ep17)
programme.desc: Tired of the busy city life, Bert has finally convinced Bruce to leave it all behind for water, grass and relaxation. However, Bert has high expectations for their new home. (由于生活繁忙,伯特最终说服布鲁斯离开一切,去享受水,草,休息.)

programme.title: Murder Below Deck ((摄影机不要停!))
programme.desc: When Lauren gives up the corporate life and a cheating boyfriend, she joins her best friend working aboard a yacht in the South Pacific. As her first voyage sets sail, she falls for entrepreneur Mark. (劳伦放弃了公司生活和一个骗子男朋友,她加入了她最好的朋友在南太平洋的游艇上工作.)

programme.title: MasterChef Australia S18 Ep39 ((厨艺大师澳洲版 S18 Ep39))
programme.desc: In the final Masters Week challenge, four contestants compete in a pressure test set by Kirsten Tibballs to avoid elimination and secure their place in the Top 10. (在最后的硕士周挑战中,四名参赛者在Kirsten Tibballs设定的压力测试中竞争,以避免被淘汰,并确保其在前10名中的位置。)

programme.title: MasterChef Australia S18 Ep40 ((厨艺大师澳洲版 S18 Ep40))
programme.desc: Its Knockout Week, and our ten cooks are faced with the infamous twins challenge inspired by MasterChef couple Sarah Todd and Declan Cleary and their identical twin girls, Charlotte and Claudia. (这场盛大的双胞胎挑战 受到马斯特涅夫夫妇Sarah Todd和Declan Cleary的启发 以及他们相同的双胞胎女孩Charlotte和Claudia)

programme.title: MasterChef Australia S18 Ep41 ((厨艺大师澳洲版 S18 Ep41))
programme.desc: As Knockout Week continues, the MasterChef judges have each filled a fridge with ingredients. Eight contestants must choose a fridge, without looking inside, and use its contents to make a dish. (随着击倒周的继续,马斯特涅夫(Masteref)法官每人都把冰箱装满了原料。 八位参赛者必须选择冰箱,而不看里面,并用冰箱的内容做盘子。)

programme.title: Rachael Rays Meals in Minutes S4 Ep12 ((Rachael Ray - 百度百科 S4 Ep12))
programme.desc: Rachael shares her secrets for the ultimate bacon jack burger, from scoring the meat for perfect portions to packing equal amounts of crispy bacon into every bite. (Rachael分享了她的秘密 最终培根杰克汉堡, 从评分肉 完美的部分 到包装同等数量 脆培根的每一口咬。)

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out S1 Ep01 ((挤痘大师: Breaking Out S1 Ep01))
programme.desc: Dottie the body lost her confidence when a bump started growing between her thighs. Dr. Lee brings in a new, young doctor to help Tim with his big, bumpy nose. Karime is insecure about her birthmark. (李医生带来了一个新年轻的医生来帮助蒂姆处理他的大,鼻子.卡里米对她的出生标志不确定.)

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out S1 Ep02 ((挤痘大师: Breaking Out S1 Ep02))
programme.desc: Katrina has oozing, smelly boils that have taken over her life. Kims head-to-toe tumours interfere with her sleep apnea mask, resulting in constant exhaustion. (凯特里娜的脑部瘤干扰了她的睡眠呼吸道膜,导致她不断疲.)

programme.title: Rachael Ray in Tuscany Ep26 (雷切尔·雷在托斯卡纳 Ep26)
programme.desc: Rachael is known for her delicious and flavourful pesto sauces of all varieties. She prepares a pesto alla trapanese, a Sicilian dish made with almonds and tomatoes. (拉切尔以各种品种的美味和美味的皮斯托而闻名.她制备了一个由杏仁和番茄制成的西西里菜,Pesto alla trapanese.)

programme.title: Husband, Father, Killer: the Alyssa Pladl Story ((乱伦杀机：普拉德尔灭门案))
programme.desc: Alyssa and Steven moved in together when Alyssa was an impressionable teen. After they have a daughter of their own, their path takes a dark turn when Steven becomes physically abusive toward the infant. (艾莉莎和史蒂文搬到了一起,当时艾莉莎还是一个令人印象深刻的青少年.)

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2 Ep06 ((野性标志 S2 Ep06))
programme.desc: The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africas amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent. (尼罗和鱼是非洲两的淡水象征,)

programme.title: Superbeast S1 Ep05 ((超级野兽 S1 Ep05))
programme.desc: Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks. (向最古老、最致命的耐力掠食动物的自然物种之一俯首称臣。 观察虎鲨利用海龟巢穴的混乱,在缺氧的环境中生存,用埃普莱特鲨鱼生存下去,用幽灵鲨鱼抵御深海的压抑压力。)

programme.title: Superbeast S1 Ep06 ((超级野兽 S1 Ep06))
programme.desc: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites. (以各种鲨鱼围观海洋,看看为什么这些掠食性鱼类在海底占优势。 与珊瑚礁鲨鱼一起跟踪珊瑚迷宫,躺在等待与大白鲨进行完美打击的等待中,与大白鲨一起开始史诗般的迁徙。)

programme.title: Rooted S1 Ep01 ((生命之树 S1 Ep01))
programme.desc: Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. (横跨波纹沙丘,在卡拉哈里南部风湿的草原上 一座雄伟的骆驼角,它在这里站了两个世纪)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia S2 Ep05 ((赞比亚传奇 S2 Ep05))
programme.desc: Zambias Luangwa Valley is home to Africas biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. (赞比亚卢旺加谷是非洲最大和最可怕的巨人所在地,)

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1 Ep03 ((Wild Side of 从地球到月球 S1 Ep03))
programme.desc: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight. (由月球力量引导的史诗之旅。看看看不见的信号如何引导海洋迁徙路线沿线的鲸鱼和海龟,带夜仓鸟横跨各大洲,并观察月光航行的鸽子和其他昆虫。)

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australias Wild West S1 Ep01 (吉姆伯利:澳大利亚野生西部S1 Ep01)
programme.desc: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives. (避免鱼的皮和羽毛的危险,看 koolamana 鱼争取伴侣,和鱼的幼儿一起吃饭.)

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives S1 Ep02 (大猫:九命S1Ep02)
programme.desc: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk. (以小小幼崽驾驭森林,看着年轻成年人拥有自己的领地,见证年长猎人不可避免的流亡。 发现本能和隐形是如何帮助老虎在孤独的世界中生存的,在这个世界中,每一个决定都会带来风险。)

programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. Why do my feet hurt?, he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them why is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggees Squirrel Club S01 - Im Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Hey Duggees Squirrel Club S01 - Whats Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken AE, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about whats hot and whats not.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Rainbow
programme.desc: After a rainbow appears over the Go Jet Academy, Glitch becomes fascinated with the legend of a pot of gold appearing at the end of it.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Kids
programme.desc: A quick trip to the shops proves tricky for Dad, when Bingo and Bluey want to play a game of Kids. Now Bluey is Mum, Bingos her baby and for Dad however, he is a very naughty boy.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Bingo
programme.desc: When Bluey has a playdate at Chloes, Bingo must learn how to play by herself. But all the games she knows need more than one person! Luckily Dad has a problem that needs solving.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Whale Watching
programme.desc: Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Family Meeting
programme.desc: When Dads accused of fluffing in Blueys face as he climbed out of bed, hes put on trial with Mum as the judge, and Bluey and Bingo as witnesses. Bluey might also have to explain what she was doing there.

programme.title: Andys Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Hatzegopteryx Display
programme.desc: When Jens drone goes missing on Dino Island, Andy heads out to track it down. He discovers one of the islands inhabitants, a giraffe-sized pterosaur, called Hatzegopteryx, is using the drone for a very special purpose.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Rubber Duck
programme.desc: In the Fortress of Fun, Kingsley and Queenie play a game of Hide-and-Quack with the Playtimers to find their missing rubber ducks.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Voice Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels start talking to each other in the wrong voices its clear something has gone awry. But Duggee has his voice badge. He knows what to do!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Stick Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are preparing to have a campfire. Duggee is getting it ready and needs the Squirrels to help find lots of wood for it. He needs small sticks, medium and big sticks... Lots of sticks!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Colour Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is painting in his favourite colouring book, and the Squirrels want to join in.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Mudslide
programme.desc: Its a very rainy day at the Go Jet Academy and the Go Jetters are teaching the Cadets some crucial Go Jetter skills. Meanwhile, Glitch has uprooted trees on the side of a large hill in order to build his rival Grim Dome Academy. But the lack of tree roots holding the soil together and the heavy rainfall leads to a mudslide! Glitch and his cadets need rescuing before they are washed away down the

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - The Sphinx, Egypt
programme.desc: Glitch and the Grimbots are on holiday in Egypt where the Grimbots bury the Great Sphinx in sand, leaving only its head showing.

programme.title: Thomas Friends S24 - Sonnys Second Chance
programme.desc: Sonny returns to Sodor to try to be a really useful engine again but some of the other trains arent willing to give him a second chance.

programme.title: Nikhil Jay S01 - Nikhil and Jay and the Deepavali Fireworks
programme.desc: Nikhil, Jay and their family celebrate Deepavali, also known as Diwali, with kolam, laddus and bunting. But will they be able to watch the fireworks without scaring Max the cat?

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Carnival
programme.desc: Stanley, Sophie and Benjamin make up a new game, Dino-Pirates. This is such a good game, they use it as inspiration for Stanleys carnival float.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Bubbles
programme.desc: Stanley cleans Cynthias bus, but each time he does it keeps getting dirty again. Its so dirty by the end, he invents a super-duper cleaning machine that makes a sea of bubbles.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - Not A Lemon... A Lem-ming!
programme.desc: Its not all cats and dogs when it comes to pets. Our talking animals have their own, very silly favourites.

programme.title: JoJo Gran Gran S01 - Its time to look after Monty
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are looking after Monty the dog for the day. Whilst JoJo would like to see Montys new rolling-over trick, she learns that theres much more to looking after a dog than just play.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Promises
programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mums word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why its important not to break them.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dads birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Luckys Dads pie.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Getting On Badge
programme.desc: When the squirrels upset the mole by being noisy, Duggee suggests ways that they can all live underground peacefully.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Dressing Up Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is wrapping a present because it is Enids birthday. But the squirrels didnt get her anything! Maybe they could give her a surprise...but Enid doesnt like surprises. Norrie suggests dressing up, what a great idea!

programme.title: Hey Duggees Squirrel Club S01 - Copy The King
programme.desc: The Squirrels play Copy the King!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Great Big Painting
programme.desc: One rainy day, Maisy and her friends make a giant painting!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Recycling Truck
programme.desc: Maisy and Tallulah drive their recycling truck around the community.

programme.title: Roots Fruits S02 - Gooseberry
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, its Gooseberry, singing a song about everything you have to do to become a Gooseberry Club member.

programme.title: Roots Fruits S02 - Festive Special
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, Carrot, Potato, Parsnip and Brussels Sprout perform the festive classic Auld Lang Syne - if Potato lands from the moon on time.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Broccoli Flies Again
programme.desc: Evil Pea asks for flying lessons when Broccoli flies her paper plane into her freezer. Evil Pea doesnt let Broccoli know that she intends to fly high to take over Tato Tower.

programme.title: Fast Furious: Spy Racers S2 - The Fugitives
programme.desc: Now that theyre officially on the run, the team heads down to Mexico City to hide out in one of Ms. Nowheres many safe houses. With super-agent Palindrome and the police hot on their tales, they decide the only way theyre going to survive is by getting their hands on some money by winning an underground derby race.

programme.title: Fast Furious: Spy Racers S2 - The Ocelot King vs. El Mariposa
programme.desc: Unable to decide how to prove their innocence, the team has a huge fight! Ms. Nowhere and Echo Pearl reach out to Palindrome with the evidence theyve collected while Tony and Cisco find Uncle Tuco at a lucha libra match, where Cisco must face the ultimate question: can you always trust family?

programme.title: Fast Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Thats a Moray
programme.desc: When the team learns of several robberies in Mexico City that resemble the attack on the agency. Ms. Nowhere puts the pieces together and realizes who set them up: an ex-operative she used to work with named Moray. Now, she and the crew must infiltrate a masquerade ball to come face to face with Moray and figure out what hes up to.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - No Bark, All Bite
programme.desc: Hiccup and Stoick set forth to find willow bark while Gobber holds a cookoff for the merchants until things go a riot and the riders have to protect Berk

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - Chain Of Command
programme.desc: Krogen is on the hunt for dragon lenses and Snotlout and Minden do their best to defend Wing Island. Back in Berk Dagur and Mala feud over keeping the lenses safe

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - Loyal Order Of Ingerman
programme.desc: After learning that his ancestors once hunted dragons Fishlegs goes out on a journey to find a Dramillion dragon while being faced with the challenge to clear his family name.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Bombastic Blathering of Brainy
programme.desc: When Krupp transfers to another school, George and Harold follow, only to find a bizarro version of Jerome Horwitz Elementary, where the teachers are nice and the kids are well-behaved. But Krupp enlists Mr. Neamer bizarro Meaner, who then super-enlargers his brain and becomes Brainy Blabulous, in ord

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Crazy Caustic Spray of the Cont
programme.desc: In order to spice up their field trip to Romeinday an ancient Rome reenactment park, George and Harold trick Melvin into turning the bus into a time machine so they can travel to actual ancient Rome and be gladiators. After offending Caesar with their comic, the emperor is accidentally turned into Cruelius Sneezer and pursues the school group with all his might.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Trashy Tale of the Tumultuous T
programme.desc: In honor of Dump Day in Piqua- celebrating the creation of the dump - George and Harold try to earn extra credit by creating a trash-alanche. But Melvin creates an invention to suck all the trash into another dimension. The plan backfires when Tubbadump, a trash-covered monster, emerges from that dimension for revenge on the trashmakers.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Big Dumpling
programme.desc: The Uncuddleables have struck the Lil Dumpling baby pageant, replacing all of Baby Corps super-cute top 5er babies with not-cute bottom 5ers. Boss, Tina and their field team race to caravan the 5ers from their homes to the pageant before Nannycam deploys the nuclear option of unleashing the dangerously cute UBO on stage to salvage a Lil Dumpling win.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Great Medieval London Fire 1135
programme.desc: Boss Baby and Tina reject the 5er system that says the cuter you are, the more love you deserve. Teaming up with the Uncuddleables, the team tries to take down the system from within, forming a resistance of the eight department heads of Baby Corp in the hopes of changing the way we look at Baby Love forever.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Untitled Templeton Project
programme.desc: Fired from Baby Corp and trying to build their own business, Boss Baby and Tina waste all their startup funds immediately, requiring a loan from Banker Baby Benny. In order to receive their seed money and get their company rolling, they have to rebuild the towns faith in a baby who made everyone miss a huge sporting even and they have to do it on a very limited budget

programme.desc: 張泉靈黃聖依等擔任少年見證官，在賽制內容上進行升級，分為搶位賽團隊輪答賽項目挑戰賽三個環節，圍繞真實生活場景與綜合性課題，著重考驗自主探究與協作破題的綜合能力；題庫覆蓋校內學科傳統文化時事邏輯等多領域，讓少年們在解題中感受思考的樂趣，在挑戰中養成自主探究的習慣.

programme.title: 迎鳳歸 短劇 She Is the Phoenix Mini drama
programme.desc: 圍繞雙重生的復仇主線展開，女主角姜樂瑤慘死後重生，發現閨蜜蓉兒頂替了自己的身份嫁入寧府，前一世她被嫁給痴傻少爺，更發現父母並非死於意外而是被人所害；這一世，她與同樣重生的伙伴聯手，直面寧府權貴的迫害，在身份置換與權謀博弈中揭露真相，為自己討回公道.

programme.title: 勿擾飛升短劇 Flying Up Without Disturb Mini drama
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師.

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃 第2季 Crush of Music Season 2 Repackaged
programme.desc: 將繼續以音樂牽線，緣分發聲為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深薛之謙單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台！.

programme.title: 日落時分說愛你 Forever By Your Side
programme.desc: 熟齡戀愛旅居真人秀，10位性格各異魅力全開的50熟齡男女，帶著一顆敢愛的心，從大理到泰國，在日落時分開啟一段愛情之旅，一同打破恐老焦慮，傳遞歲月從不敗熱愛的生活態度.

programme.title: 味解鄉愁 Wei Jie Xiang Chou
programme.desc: 以紀實的方式表現人與家鄉美食的情感故事，通過尋訪有異鄉經歷或者當地長者手藝人的典型故事，傳達出美食對他們的家鄉符號意義；不僅表達了對美食產生的情感記憶，還充分展現菜餚的歷史文化厚度和純正的江蘇味道.

programme.title: 煥新環遊傳 Travel With The Royal Family
programme.desc: 蔡少芬陶昕然斕曦張曉龍藍盈瑩陳思斯楊九郎時隔13年後首次合體重聚，以全新的面貌組成煥新團，從承載無數記憶的甄嬛傳拍攝地北京大觀園出發，自北向南，由東向西，前往全國多個寶藏民族文化發源地，通過深度探訪遊學，體驗各地民俗文化和風土人情，帶著回憶和新的憧憬環遊全國以完成煥新之旅.

programme.title: Oppss Terpikat Cik Sombong
programme.desc: Marlia marah kerana Hans membuatkan Ira jatuh. Sikap Ira yang tetap kasar dan kurang sopan terhadap Hans membuatkan Rashid marah. Rashid menasihati Hans supaya mendidik Ira menjadi isteri yang baik. Rashid mahu Hans mula bekerja di syarikatnya kerana Ira sudah semakin pulih. Marlia tidak setuju. Marlia masih menganggap Hans orang asing yang hanya mahu mengambil kesempatan ke atas kekayaan keluarga mereka. Marlia mahu Ira cepat sembuh dan meminta cerai dari Hans. Ira pula semakin bosan dan tertekan dengan desakan Marlia. Sedikit demi sedikit Ira mula dapat menerima kehadiran Hans. Hans mengajak Ira ke pantai untuk berehat dan menjalani terapi kaki. Ira setuju tetapi tidak mahu memberitahu Marlia. Apabila Marlia dapat tahu dia begitu marah dan bimbang jika Ira jatuh cinta dengan Hans.

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Taufik cuba merebut perhatian Ana dari Johan tanpa menyedari yang Edora dan Johan sedang memerhatikan mereka. Mereka berasa cemburu kerana dapat melihat ada sesuatu di antara Taufik dan Ana dari cara mereka berbual dan memandang satu sama lain. Edora tertolak Taufik hingga kakinya terseliuh.

programme.title: Pesan Pada Hati
programme.desc: Yusuf berusaha mendekati Zulaikha, namun Zulaikha risau kerana ibunya, Hajar Liza Abdullah, pernah berpesan untuk tidak jatuh cinta pada lelaki di Kuala Lumpur. Hajar kecewa apabila anaknya, Aakif, tidak pernah pulang ke kampung setelah berkahwin dengan gadis bandar

Anggara dan Aini merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang hidup bahagia. Namun, menjelang ulang tahun perkahwinan mereka, Aini disahkan menghidap penyakit otak yang menyebabkan dia kehilangan ingatan secara berperingkat sehingga tidak lagi mengenali suaminya sendiri. Dalam tempoh yang semakin singkat, Anggara berusaha mempertahankan cinta mereka sambil menemani Aini menghadapi detik-detik paling sukar dalam hidupnya. Selepas pemergian Aini, sebuah rakaman video yang ditinggalkannya mendedahkan rahsia yang mengubah kehidupan Anggara buat selama-lamanya.

programme.title: Deko Bajet

programme.title: Aroma Masak
programme.desc: Hani Fadzil selaku hos musim ini akan menyediakan 2 menu istimewa iaitu Daging Cincang Kailan Popia Ketam Pedas sambil ditemani oleh artis jemputan, Naki.

programme.title: Saat Aku Tahu

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Usop cuba dapatkan wok dengan mencari deris. Namun siapa diri deris sudah mulai terbongkar. Dia tidak endah permintaan usop mengenai pemergiaan maimun. Betapa kejamnya deris, tidak langsung membawa wok balik untuk melihat arwah maimun untuk kali terakhir. Wok disiksa teruk dan tekad cuba membunuh deris.

programme.title: Misteri Mona
programme.desc: Anom mendakwa mendengar suara Mona dari loteng. Rasa curiga Farah terhadap Dr. Nadeem semakin memuncak apabila dia menyedari perwatakan dan nasihat doktor itu tidak meyakinkan.

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Taufik keliru dengan perasaannya kerana sering terbayangkan Ana lalu mengadu kepada Dato Ishmael tanpa pengetahuan Johan. Johan pula mengadu kepada Nani yang dia syak Ana sukakan Taufik. Ana cuba yakinkan Johan yang dia betul suka terhadapnya, bukan Taufik walaupun dia sendiri mula meragui perasaannya. Edora juga semakin rasa tercabar dengan Ana dan sering resah gelisah.

programme.title: Oppss Terpikat Cik Sombong
programme.desc: Hans menukar penampilan setelah dipaksa oleh Imran. Marlia dan Ira begitu terperanjat melihat penampilan Hans yang begitu kacak sekali. Ira dah mula rasa cemburu apabila Hans memuji Farah, salah seorang pekerja di syarikat mereka. Ira yang telah boleh berjalan terus sahaja meminta supaya dia mula kembali bekerja. Ketika membelibelah baju baru untuk ke pejabat bersama Hans, tiba-tiba Reez muncul di depan Ira. Reez minta diberi peluang kedua tetapi Ira telah lama membenci Reez. Ira terus pergi meninggalkan Reez. Ira mula merasaan dia selamat dan gembira bila bersama Hans. Walaupun bicara Ira terhadap Hans tetap kasar tetapi nadanya sudah berbeza dari dulu. Marlia perasan akan perubahan pada Ira. Marlia minta Ira tunaikan janjinya untuk berpisah dengan Hans. Ira mengadu kepada Imran dan memberitahu yang dia tidak sanggup berpisah dengan lelaki yang baik seperti Hans.

Namun, selepas kematian ayah Hawa, ibu Hawa, Suzana, enggan berhubung rapat dengan keluarga Adam, walaupun ayah Adam, Zul, beberapa kali cuba mendekatinya. Hawa percaya dia dan Adam ditakdirkan bersama, tetapi mereka jarang berkomunikasi. Hawa seorang gadis pendiam, gemar warna hitam, mekap pelik, dan muzik

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Wok terus didera, diikat. Sesekali dilayan, selalu lebih kepada hamba abdi. Deris semakin lupa daratan. Usop masih belum dapat mencari wok. Deris mula mendapat selera baru. Cuba menlanggani wani, budak baru berjinak-jinak menjadi call girl. Paling sedih, wani adalah adik Alai.

programme.title: Assasins Target
programme.desc: Seorang wanita pembunuh beracun dalam misi pencarian dan pemusnahan terhadap seorang pemimpin spiritual yang misteri.

programme.title: Losmen Melati
programme.desc: Seorang bapa yang ingin membalas dendam atas kematian isteri dan anaknya yang terbunuh mengikuti pembunuh, seorang pengutip hutang, kepada losmen pada suatu malam. Dengan pembunuh yang tinggal di bilik sebelah, kali ini hantu berlaku bukan dalam satu bilik tetapi dua. Dalam kejutan yang mengejutkan, di antara harta benda si mati, Golok menjumpai keratan akhbar lama yang menggambarkan sebuah keluarga yang hilang di motel berhantu itu, membayangkan bahawa bukan kebetulan mereka terjumpa Losmen Melati pada malam sebelumnya. Berapa ramai lagi yang tahu tentang rumah tamu terkutuk itu dan apakah masalah masa depan yang akan dibawa oleh ini?

programme.title: Decibel
programme.desc: Kisah ini bermula apabila sebutir bom yang bertindak balas terhadap bunyi ditemui di pusat bandar.

programme.title: Parole Examiner Lee EP12
programme.desc: Myeong-seob ditahan tetapi Dong-man terus cuba melepaskan diri dengan kuasanya. Han-shin membentangkan bukti penyalahgunaan sistem parol oleh Ojung Group. Akhirnya, Dong-man didakwa dan Han-shin terus berjuang untuk mereformasikan sistem parol.

programme.title: Danur 3

programme.title: Gemerlapan
programme.desc: Mimi mengejutkan ramai pelajar di sebuah kolej berprestij kerana menjadi seorang penggemar muzik dangdut yang tegar. Nel, salah seorang pelajar di situ menganggap muzik dangdut kekampungan dan mereka berdua sering bertengkar kerana hal tersebut. Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: Jogho
programme.desc: Dendam menguasai masyarakat Melayu Patani di Thailand Selatan. Kalah dalam pertempuran lembu jantan, lawannya dibunuh yang juga saudara kepada Mamat - yang berjanji untuk membalas dendam bagi kematian saudaranya. Sifat dendam dalam masyarakat Melayu tetap mengalir kerana isteri Mamat, Minah gagal untuk menghentikan kitaran kejam itu.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk Jangan Bernafas. Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai footage menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.title: Suratan Kasih
programme.desc: Sunny mengalami tekanan jiwa selepas melihat ibunya yang sedang berzina mati dibunuh ayahnya sendiri. Apabila meningkat dewasa, Sunny menjadi seorang pembunuh bersiri di sebalik kerjayanya sebagai komposer dan pemuzik. Mangsanya ialah golongan artis yang melakukan perbuatan zina. Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Rahsia
programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Imigran
programme.desc: Faridah, pekerja warga asing terlibat dalam kes jenayah apabila telah menjadi saksi kes pembunuhan. Bertemu Hisham ketika cuba melarikan diri, mereka berdua mula jatuh cinta selepas menghabiskan masa bersama di kampung Hisham. Konflik berlaku apabila penjenayah tersilap menculik orang yang menyebabkan Faridah dan Hisham perlu melakukan sesuatu untuk menyelamatkan Azura.

programme.title: Mama Oh Mama
programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: The Trembling of Cicada Whats On Today ((蝉 Whats On Today))
programme.desc: A criminal defense lawyer Zhong Chuxi whose biological father is a kidnapper and whose stepfather is a police detective a judge Francis Ng who lost his wife and children years ago in revenge and a charismatic legal elite Zheng Yunlong who is adept at manipulating people and navigating the gray areasthese three lonely strangers engage in a battle of wits in the criminal defense of hard-hitting cases, yet grow to appreciate each other more and more. They are rivals who are also like family. Like the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind, the three are both prey and hunter to each other. Who is the oriole, and who is the cicada that has been lying dormant for twelve years, just to sing freely and reap a season of resounding summer?

programme.title: Seoul follow me! (首尔跟我来!)
programme.desc: Following the trend means going along with a fashion or trend. Host Du Rufeng watched videos with millions of views on online platforms, meticulously following the characters footsteps to visit shopping and entertainment spots in Seoul, South Korea, and trying all the recommended restaurants and shops featured in the videos. But are these videos, viewed by millions, just hype to lure viewers in, or are they truly worth recommending? Rufeng transformed into a real-life keyboard warrior, leaving incredibly honest comments. Besides this, following the trend can also have another meaning: following Rufengs personal recommendations and then creating your own unique journey, allowing viewers to legitimately follow the trend!

programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot ((中文))
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation with limited resources, they had to use any means necessary to achieve their goals (了解当地习俗和文化的最佳方式是深入旅行,探索城市的每个角落,徒步旅行,探索整个城市的每个角落,欣赏沿途的风景,发现当地的生活和文化,迎接出乎意料的意外和挑战。 什乔里和蔡清春被一个制作团队引诱到台湾拍摄一个真实的节目。 从高雄机场开始,他们征服了300多公里,从太南到台北,在8天里访问了8个城市,每天只有1 000图亚,两个城市用他们的大脑解决交通和食品等问题,同时完成各种任务,甚至用有限的资源换房,他们不得不使用任何必要的手段实现其目标。)

programme.title: Big Boys Club ((Big Boys Club兄弟幫 - 外星來客))
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. programme.title: War Of Thorns ((玫瑰战争))
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying Yoyo Chen committed suicide, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung Tavia Yeung somehow obtains Tsz-yings diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her nice sisters Lai Yi-wan Rosina Lam, Lam Fung-yee Elaine Yiu, Leung Fei-nga Kelly Fu and Lam On-on Judy Kwong. To uncover the truth and avenge her friends death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film The Rose as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang Moses Chan over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-yings secret lover Lee Tak-lung Kenneth Ma and uses a series of accidents that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-yings death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyones glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: The Trembling of Cicada ((蝉))
programme.desc: A criminal defense lawyer Zhong Chuxi whose biological father is a kidnapper and whose stepfather is a police detective a judge Francis Ng who lost his wife and children years ago in revenge and a charismatic legal elite Zheng Yunlong who is adept at manipulating people and navigating the gray areasthese three lonely strangers engage in a battle of wits in the criminal defense of hard-hitting cases, yet grow to appreciate each other more and more. They are rivals who are also like family. Like the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind, the three are both prey and hunter to each other. Who is the oriole, and who is the cicada that has been lying dormant for twelve years, just to sing freely and reap a season of resounding summer?

programme.title: Seoul follow me! (首尔跟我来!)
programme.desc: Following the trend means going along with a fashion or trend. programme.title: Happy Old Buddies ((开心老友记))
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. programme.title: News Treasury 2026 ((新闻掏宝 2026))
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences. programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot ((中文))
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation with limited resources, they had to use any means necessary to achieve their goals (了解当地习俗和文化的最佳方式是深入旅行,探索城市的每个角落,徒步旅行,探索整个城市的每个角落,欣赏沿途的风景,发现当地的生活和文化,迎接出乎意料的意外和挑战。 什乔里和蔡清春被一个制作团队引诱到台湾拍摄一个真实的节目。 从高雄机场开始,他们征服了300多公里,从太南到台北,在8天里访问了8个城市,每天只有1 000图亚,两个城市用他们的大脑解决交通和食品等问题,同时完成各种任务,甚至用有限的资源换房,他们不得不使用任何必要的手段实现其目标。)

programme.title: War Of Thorns ((玫瑰战争))
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying Yoyo Chen committed suicide, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung Tavia Yeung somehow obtains Tsz-yings diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her nice sisters Lai Yi-wan Rosina Lam, Lam Fung-yee Elaine Yiu, Leung Fei-nga Kelly Fu and Lam On-on Judy Kwong. To uncover the truth and avenge her friends death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film The Rose as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang Moses Chan over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-yings secret lover Lee Tak-lung Kenneth Ma and uses a series of accidents that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-yings death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyones glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Big Boys Club ((Big Boys Club兄弟幫 - 外星來客))

In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience. (大男孩俱乐部是一款由一群亲密朋友Bob Lam,Oscar Leung,Derek Wong,Philip Fan和Alan Chan主办的青年谈话节目.在每个集中,歌手,演员或来自不同领域的客人都被邀请进行放松的面试,介绍了包括当前社会问题,流行文化和流行兴趣在内的广泛的主题.爱情,关系甚至同性关系等问题是不止讨论的主题.该节目邀请来自不同背景的客人探索爱情和关系,深入性别之间的动态.其他维度段有客人分享非凡的经验,如遇到鬼魂,UFO和奇怪事件,将兴奋的主题带到观众.)

programme.title: Hands Up 2026 ((举起手来! 2026))
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge. programme.title: Big City Shop 2026 ((全信没收))
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges. (随着大城市商店的推广,观众们可以了解到各种及时的主题,包括季节性产品,健康和健康,健身活动,护肤和化,时尚服装,婴儿护理,家长知识,当地精致食品和物护理趋势.内容是全面的!除了主持人实践示范,体验或测试外,专家也被邀请分享他们的专业见解.在菜领域,几位熟练的菜专家轮流展示简单而美味的健康菜和家庭式食谱,帮助每个人都解决风格的挑战.)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: The Trembling of Cicada Whats On Today ((蝉 Whats On Today))
programme.desc: A criminal defense lawyer Zhong Chuxi whose biological father is a kidnapper and whose stepfather is a police detective a judge Francis Ng who lost his wife and children years ago in revenge and a charismatic legal elite Zheng Yunlong who is adept at manipulating people and navigating the gray areasthese three lonely strangers engage in a battle of wits in the criminal defense of hard-hitting cases, yet grow to appreciate each other more and more. They are rivals who are also like family. Like the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind, the three are both prey and hunter to each other. Who is the oriole, and who is the cicada that has been lying dormant for twelve years, just to sing freely and reap a season of resounding summer?

programme.title: Seoul follow me! (首尔跟我来!)
programme.desc: Following the trend means going along with a fashion or trend. Host Du Rufeng watched videos with millions of views on online platforms, meticulously following the characters footsteps to visit shopping and entertainment spots in Seoul, South Korea, and trying all the recommended restaurants and shops featured in the videos. But are these videos, viewed by millions, just hype to lure viewers in, or are they truly worth recommending? Rufeng transformed into a real-life keyboard warrior, leaving incredibly honest comments. Besides this, following the trend can also have another meaning: following Rufengs personal recommendations and then creating your own unique journey, allowing viewers to legitimately follow the trend!

programme.title: Cantoxicating! Sr.4
programme.desc: The Cantonese word gaigui ?? is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the Gaigui Guided Tour to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various goddesses and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5 ((阿爷厨房 Sr.5))
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how! (李建丁师,坚强的老师丁,无疑是武术的士,但他厨艺技巧也令人印象深刻!丁师与精明的食品熟练者坦尤宁合作建立了士丁厨房.每集都带着观众去寻找他们最喜欢的食材,丁师亲自做各种特色的菜,和甜点,提供怀旧的堪敦式美食!如何以负担得起的价格做真实的传统烤?如何控制鱼时的热量和时间?秋冬,许多人喜欢香水米,特别是脆的米皮.但你有没有见过士丁的米米两侧都显示了米米的米技巧吗?看看看!)

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Chun Hui
programme.desc: Chun Hui tells the inspiring true story of Ge Jianhao, an extraordinary mother who broke away from feudal traditions in rural Hunan to pursue revolutionary ideals. After unbinding her feet, she defied poverty and social prejudice to move her family across China and all the way to France for a work-study program. Studying alongside the younger generation, she championed womens education and supported the early Communist movement. Through her unwavering guidance, her childrenincluding key pioneers Cai Hesen, Cai Chang, and daughter-in-law Xiang Jingyubecame prominent leaders of the Communist Party of China.

programme.title: Lelio PoPo (莱利奥波波)
programme.desc: Former radio DJs KK and Ah Luke were once hugely popular, but their bad attitudes and eccentric behaviour got them fired. Desperate for a comeback, they audition for a new radio station searching for elderly female hosts. Disguising themselves as old ladies, the pair unexpectedly land the job and spark a series of hilarious misadventures. (从前的DJ KK和Ah Luke电台曾经非常受欢迎,但他们的不良态度和以极端为中心的行为使他们被解雇了。 迫不及待地回访,他们为寻找老年女性主机的新电台试镜。 假扮自己是老太太,这对夫妇出乎意料地找到了工作,引发了一系列可笑的冒险。)

programme.title: The Italian Recipe ((遇见你之后))
programme.desc: Famous pop idol Peng travels to Rome for a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Mang, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. Peng and Mang have nothing in common but spend a magical night in Rome together. Their lives begin to change as the two start to fall in love. (著名的流行偶像彭派去罗马参加一个现实秀,遇到一个梦想成为意大利大厨的普通女孩曼格(Mang ) 。 彭曼除了在罗马共度一个神奇的夜晚之外,没有什么共同之处。 随着两人开始相爱,他们的生活开始发生变化。)

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller ((冰封侠：时空行者))
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap. (在这次续集中,四位帝国卫兵在现代香港被解冻并重新复活。 受一个单一目标驱使,以获得黄金时代之门并纠正过去的错误,英英开始冒险追求,不知道每一步都让他陷入致命陷阱。)

programme.title: Love Punch ((私恋失调))
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Ip Man 3 ((叶问3))
programme.desc: When some gangsters led by a ruthless American property developer force a school to sell their land, Ip Man fights to protect it. Subsequently, Ip Man is challenged by another Wing Chun master Zhang Tian Zhi for the Grandmaster title. Ip Man accepts the challenge for the sake of his family and disciples, and wins the duel for the title. (当一些由无情的美国房地产开发者领导的黑帮组织迫使一所学校出售他们的土地时,叶问会为保护土地而斗争。 随后,叶问会受到另一位翼中大师张天志的反对。 叶问会为家族和门徒接受挑战,赢得冠军。)

programme.title: The Ex-files 4: Marriage Plan ((前任4：英年早婚))
programme.desc: Two brothers, Meng Yun and Yu Fei, are of marriageable age and are facing challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, while Fei and his girlfriend opt for a marriage cooling-off period to tackle marriage issues. (孟云和优飞这两个兄弟已经到了适婚年龄,在恋爱中面临挑战。 云在分手后逃避家庭结婚的压力,而飞及其女朋友选择婚姻冷却期来解决婚姻问题。)

programme.title: Tales from the Occult: Ultimate Malevolence ((失衡凶间之恶念之最))
programme.desc: The final chapter of Tales From The Occult, the movie features three short stories about two high school friends, a magician undergoing hypnosis to find her missing friend, and a man finding his way out of a mysterious building. The stories reveal the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: Born to Fly ((长空之王))
programme.desc: Lei Yu has officially become the new generation of Chinese test pilots after rounds of strict selection. Captain Zhang Ting leads Lei Yu and other pilots to test the latest fighter jets. Lei Yu keeps pushing the limits in each test flight in the hope of coming up with the perfect plane to ensure the safety of the fighter pilots. (莱由正式成为经过几轮严格挑选的新一代中国试飞飞行员。 张婷船长带领李玉和其他飞行员测试最新的喷气式战斗机。 莱由不断推进每次试飞的极限,希望能够搭上完美的飞机确保战斗机飞行员的安全。)

programme.title: Love is Blind, Hate Too ((致命24小时))
programme.desc: Bo lost her eye sight in a serious car accident a year ago. One day, she is left alone at home when her husband is away on a work trip. An intruder enters Bos house and takes her hostage. As Bo tries to survive his mental and psychological torture, she discovers her husbands secret which is related to the accident leading to her blindness

programme.title: Shining For One Thing ((一闪一闪亮星星))
programme.desc: Zhang Wan Sen plans to confess his crush on Lin Bei Xing after the college entrance exam, but an accident changes everything tragically. As Zhang feels helpless and devastated, he fortuitously travels back in time with Lin before the accident happens. Can he make amends and convey his regrets this time? (张万森计划承认在大学入学考试后对林贝星的迷恋,但悲剧性地发生了事故。 张万森感到无助和沮丧,在事故发生前,他偶然地与林文一起回到了过去。 他这次能弥补并转达他的遗憾吗?)

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience ((沈默杀机))
programme.desc: Due to the negligence of sharp-tongued barrister Adrian, his innocent client is convicted of murder and sentenced to 17 years in jail. An opportunity to appeal the case and free his client arises a few years later, but in order to right his wrong, he must fight against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong for justice to prevail. (由于Adrian大律师的尖锐疏忽,他的无辜当事人被判犯有谋杀罪并被判处17年监禁。 几年后,他有机会上诉并释放他的当事人,但为了纠正他的错误,他必须同香港最有权势的家庭之一斗争,以伸张正义。)

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians ((镖人))
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive Zhi Shi Lang across the desert to Changan, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Out of Order ((乱套了))
programme.desc: A successful lawyers secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos. (一个成功的律师秘密的事件变成了梦, 当一个尸体突然出现在酒店房间,)

programme.title: Love For All Seasons (爱情是每一个季节)
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the Heartbroken Sword style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending? (梅是艾尔梅宗派的代理领导者,她治愈了富裕的玩乐男孩虎的不可治愈的疾病.在她老人的威胁下,梅寻求老虎的帮助,以经历心碎和掌握心碎剑风格,以击败她的老人和维护艾尔梅宗派.)

programme.title: One and Only ((我的唯一))
programme.desc: Veteran street dancer Ding Lei, invites passionate street dancer, Chen Shuo to his dance club. Sparks fly when Chen dances with the clubs top dancers. Chen pursues his dream to perform but discovers that Ding has invited him for another reason. As both of them deal with hard times, can they turn the tide on the challenges that they are facing? (古老的街头舞者丁雷(Ding Lei)邀请热情的街头舞者陈秀去他的舞厅。 陈秀去他的舞厅。 当陈舞者与俱乐部顶尖舞者共舞时,斯帕克斯会飞翔。 陈追求他的梦想是为了表演,但发现丁氏邀请他是出于另一个原因。 由于他们两人都面对困难时期,他们能否扭转他们所面临的挑战?)

programme.title: The Last Tycoon ((最后的大亨))
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war. (黑帮手陈达升上了权力的上层阶层,但发现自己被两名女性的爱情,秘密服务的谋杀阴谋和迫在眉的战争威胁之间撕裂.)

programme.title: Last Suspect ((拯救嫌疑人))
programme.desc: Lawyer Chen receives a mysterious call demanding her to defend a murder suspect after her daughter is kidnapped, and is told that she can only save her daughter by winning the case. As she starts investigation with the police and evidence emerges, Chen discovers the truth and reveals the mastermind. Can she rescue her daughter in time? (陈律师接到神秘电话,要求她在女儿被绑架后为谋杀案嫌疑人辩护,并被告知她只能通过胜诉来拯救女儿。 当她开始与警方调查并发现证据时,陈律师发现了真相并揭露了主谋。 她能及时救出女儿吗?)

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space ((奸人鬼))
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together. (一个父母分居的年轻男孩试图在生活中找到幸福。 有一天,他遇见和交朋友的是一个善良的仁爱心,他决定让父母团聚,让他真正幸福。)

programme.title: The Silver Fox ((银狐))
programme.desc: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daughter in hatred, training her into the fearsome Silver Fox and sending her out for revenge.

programme.title: Blue Skies ((碧云天))
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show. (云在11点时替换另一位歌手,成为一夜之间一场轰动.她的成功却以高昂的价格来,因为她对钢琴家的爱情受到了痛苦.)

programme.title: Killers Five (五号杀手)
programme.desc: The Dukes daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters. (杜克斯女儿被臭名昭著的金龙山强盗绑架.一个名叫贝的剑手被派去拯救她,在旅途中预计许多危险,获得了来自一群善良的朋友的帮助,他们也是功夫大师.)

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-killer ((猎人))
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else? (Tycoon Zhou是一个订婚的花花公子,但这并不阻止他尽可能多地对女士施展魅力。 他有一本关于他浪漫的幻想的日记,很快,他所亲密的女子就被一对一地杀害。 周成为警方的头号嫌疑犯,但凶手是另一个人吗?)

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts ((少林武王))
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples. (清政府指派战士摧毁少林寺并杀害所有门徒,但其中两人成功逃脱。 他们分别接受不同师傅的训练并学习了翼春和洪川的风格,最终杀害了这些战士,并对同门徒的死亡进行了报复。)

programme.title: Sweet And Wild ((野姑娘))
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back? (是一个的村子女孩,她不怕反击暴徒.她遇到了最大的子的麻烦,当她与女仆打败他的计划时,让策划复仇.)

programme.title: Raw Passions ((裸血))
programme.desc: Mrs Lins husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lins husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too! (林夫夫和他的朋友都和一个肚子舞者萨萨发生了情侣关系,两人都被她勒索.萨萨有一天被刺伤,她的兄弟出现要求钱.一个神秘的人还声称他可以提供现金证据来帮助林夫.)

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler ((玉女嬉春))
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping Irene Chen I-ling and Pai-hung Betty Ting Pei and ends when they are cast in a new movie. (导演伊诺伊·乌梅茨古在"黄"中迎接了夜总表演者的光世界.该电影描绘了两位歌唱妹妹,清平爱琳·陈·灵和挂贝蒂·廷·佩的斗争,并在新电影中被演出时结束.)

programme.title: Black Magic 2 ((勾魂降头))
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sings wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients? (辛格医生对病人奇怪的症状感到困惑,并要求他的朋友帮忙.这场疾病显然是由一个邪恶的人康的黑魔法引起的.康贪图辛格妻子的美丽,并对她发出邪恶的爱情咒语,同时威胁要杀死辛格.辛格能拯救他的妻子和病患吗?)

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor ((教头))
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wongs caught in the Mongs territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Pings limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan (铁扇公主)
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fans fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master. (唐三藏及其门徒被火烈山阻挡,只有铁扇公主的粉丝才能扑灭火焰。 被公牛魔王及其妻子拒绝的孙武康必须赶过他们才能得到火烈山。 穿越后,他们落入白骨魔姐妹的陷阱,而武贡必须利用他的力量来救他的主人。)

programme.title: The Crimson Palm ((血手印))
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy familys daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his familys background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiance, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence? (可怜的林文学家与富家女订婚,但她父亲因其家庭背景而看不起他。在出国参加皇室考试之前,林文探亲,只为了发现一个死在血中的女佣。 当现场发现他的血迹时,他成了主要嫌疑犯。 宝法官能证明他无罪吗?)

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel ((保镖))
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiance to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince ((少林传人))
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire. (两个皇室兄弟在叛逆的将军篡夺王位后作为婴儿被分开。 分裂后,少林寺和高贵的领主将一个在少林寺内,另一个在高贵的领主的统治下,他们成长为强大的武术艺术家。 当命运使他们重聚时,兄弟们必须结合其致命的武术风格来推翻暴君,为垮台的帝国报仇。)

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins ((十二金钱镖))
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - Twelve Deadly Coins and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: When The Clouds Roll By ((当云匆匆消散时))
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love. (苏是一个精神分裂症患者,她拒绝相信她的飞行员爱人在飞机事故中丧生,并发明故事来处理事情.她遇到了老同学莱,他也是医生,他找到了治疗她的疾病的方法.苏慢慢恢复并接受现实,以及她的新发现的爱.)

programme.title: One Way Only ((单程路))
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Dannys help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out

programme.title: Dawn Will Come ((魂断奈何天))
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her (梁才给美丽的邱荣下了药,强奸了她,但答应在得到父母同意后娶她。此后,没有关于他求婚的消息,而邱荣在发现自己怀孕时与梁才对质。这时,她发现他已经娶了一个高贵的富裕女孩,甚至计划杀害她。)

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind ((七煞))
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys? (王宫命令部长将他们推到部,并从内部拆散.随着更多内部冲突发生,)

programme.title: Veeran
programme.desc: A 15-year-old boy living in Veeranor, gets struck by lightning and goes into a short coma. After recovery, he gradually realizes that he has superpowers of lightning and mind control.

programme.title: Theerkatharisi
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger repeatedly calls the police control room, tipping them off about impending crimes and accidents.

programme.title: Ravanasura
programme.desc: Junior lawyer, Ravindra, agrees to help a business magnate clear her fathers name of murder, but his true colors are revealed as more bodies appear.

programme.title: KGF: Chapter 2
programme.desc: Rocky successfully rises as the leader and saviour of the people of the Kolar Gold Fields. But, in his goal to fulfil his mothers wishes, Rocky must tackle Adheera, Inayat Khalil and Ramika Sen.

programme.title: Nota
programme.desc: After a CM is charged with corruption, he is forced to pass the baton to his son. He with no political experience, finds himself stuck to the chair.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.desc: Vikram, A Pragmatic Policeman, And His Partner Simon Are On The Hunt To Capture Vedha. When Vedha Voluntarily Surrenders, He Offers To Tell Vikram A Story, Throwing Vikrams Life Into Disarray.

programme.title: Thirumanam
programme.desc: Very much concerned about his familys financial status, Arivudainambi is unhappy with the way his sisters wedding to a wealthy man is being done.

programme.title: Sivalinga
programme.desc: Raheem gets killed when he tries to save a blind man in a train. When the police close the case stating suicide, Raheems girlfriend asks Shivalingeshwaran, a CID officer, to investigate the death.

programme.title: Turbo
programme.desc: A snail named Turbo gains super-speed. He dreams of racing in the Indianapolis 500. With his friends, he defies odds to prove anyone can achieve their dreams.

programme.title: Ten Hours
programme.desc: A bus murder investigation unfolds, revealing possible scenarios and suspects. As people are questioned, deeper secrets surface, suggesting hidden motives and surprising links within the case.

programme.title: Regai
programme.desc: SI Vetri finds severed hands in an ice cart. A fingerprint links them to his friend Amuthan, believed dead. His probe exposes a medical trial cover-up staged as accidents.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons ((野性标志))
programme.desc: The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africas amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed for thousands of years, evolving in different ways to a life aquatic. (尼罗河鳄和河马是非洲的两个两栖淡水图标,它们存在于整个非洲大陆的水道、河流和湖泊中,包括南非夸祖鲁纳塔尔惊人的荒野。 这两个物种在几千年中共存,以不同方式演变为水生生物。)

programme.title: Superbeast ((超级野兽))

(向最古老、最致命的耐力掠食动物的自然物种之一俯首称臣。 观察虎鲨利用海龟巢穴的混乱,在缺氧的环境中生存,用埃普莱特鲨鱼生存下去,用幽灵鲨鱼抵御深海的压抑压力。)

programme.title: Superbeast ((超级野兽))
programme.desc: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites. (以各种鲨鱼围观海洋,看看为什么这些掠食性鱼类在海底占优势。 与珊瑚礁鲨鱼一起跟踪珊瑚迷宫,躺在等待与大白鲨进行完美打击的等待中,与大白鲨一起开始史诗般的迁徙。)

programme.title: Rooted ((生命之树))
programme.desc: Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures. (横跨波纹沙丘,在卡拉哈里南部风湿的草原上,一座雄伟的骆驼角,它在这里站了两个世纪。这棵树从来不孤单,知道它如何为许多生物提供食物、住所和狩猎场。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Zambias Luangwa Valley is home to Africas biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer. (桑比亚斯·卢昂瓦谷是非洲最大和最可怕的巨人的家园,但真正使它特别的是它的鸟类。这里有400多个不同的物种,每个物种都完全适合利用每一个机会。)

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon ((Wild Side of 从地球到月球))
programme.desc: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight. (由月球力量引导的史诗之旅。看看看不见的信号如何引导海洋迁徙路线沿线的鲸鱼和海龟,带夜仓鸟横跨各大洲,并观察月光航行的鸽子和其他昆虫。)

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australias Wild West (吉姆伯利:澳大利亚西部)
programme.desc: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives. (避免鱼的皮和羽毛的危险,看 koolamana 鱼争取伴侣,和鱼的幼儿一起吃饭.)

programme.title: Rooted ((生命之树))
programme.desc: Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures. (横跨波纹沙丘,在卡拉哈里南部风湿的草原上,一座雄伟的骆驼角,它在这里站了两个世纪。这棵树从来不孤单,知道它如何为许多生物提供食物、住所和狩猎场。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Zambias Luangwa Valley is home to Africas biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer. (桑比亚斯·卢昂瓦谷是非洲最大和最可怕的巨人的家园,但真正使它特别的是它的鸟类。这里有400多个不同的物种,每个物种都完全适合利用每一个机会。)

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon ((Wild Side of 从地球到月球))
programme.desc: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight. (由月球力量引导的史诗之旅。看看看不见的信号如何引导海洋迁徙路线沿线的鲸鱼和海龟,带夜仓鸟横跨各大洲,并观察月光航行的鸽子和其他昆虫。)

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australias Wild West (吉姆伯利:澳大利亚西部)
programme.desc: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives. (避免鱼的皮和羽毛的危险,看 koolamana 鱼争取伴侣,和鱼的幼儿一起吃饭.)

programme.title: Wildlife Icons ((野性标志))
programme.desc: The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africas amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed for thousands of years, evolving in different ways to a life aquatic. (尼罗河鳄和河马是非洲的两个两栖淡水图标,它们存在于整个非洲大陆的水道、河流和湖泊中,包括南非夸祖鲁纳塔尔惊人的荒野。 这两个物种在几千年中共存,以不同方式演变为水生生物。)

programme.desc: Battle harsh environments and relentless challenges and see how the leopard constantly outthinks its enemies to secure food and protect its young. Cross icy peaks and arid riverbeds, where any encounter can change this cats fate for better or worse.

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australias Ocean Wonder ((宁格鲁：澳大利亚的海洋奇观))
programme.desc: Learn how Ningaloos conservation miracle could inspire humans to pull the planet back from the brink of climatic destruction. Visit an abandoned whaling station and other ruins that show we have the tools, if only we can find the will to change. (学习宁格洛斯保护奇迹如何激励人类将地球从气候破坏的边缘拉回。 参观废弃的捕鲸站和其他废墟,这些废墟表明我们拥有工具,如果我们能找到改变的意志的话。)

programme.title: Surviving The Amazon ((挑战亚马逊))
programme.desc: A jaguar stalks the riverbank. A venomous snake is on the move. A Colombian tarantula waits for night fall. Watch as these fierce predators prowl through the jungle and bite into their next great meal. (瓜着河岸. 有毒的蛇在行动中. 哥伦比亚的鱼等待夜幕落. 看着这些凶猛的掠食者穿越林,咬进下一个伟大的食物.)

programme.title: Rooted ((生命之树))
programme.desc: Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation. (发现深受爱戴的香肠树的故事,它花蜜盛开,香肠制成的水果吸引各种动物,从昆虫到大象。 看看依赖这棵慷慨的树的动物如何确保它的扩散。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continents animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends. (非洲是一个充满独特和非凡的动物的大陆,其生命是由数百万年的进化过程塑造的。非洲也是人类的诞生地。我们在自己的进化历程上与各大陆的动物一起旅行,然而智慧使我们走上了一条完全不同的道路。我们的好奇心引出了关于我们周围世界的问题,这些问题通过故事、神话和传说得到了解答。)

programme.title: 艳阳天
programme.desc: 钢琴师李燕南与乐队指挥女儿陈小芸相爱，常指点她歌唱技巧小芸在一次代替演出中一鸣惊人，得团主及花花公子杜邦杰力捧小芸赴星马演出，心却惦念燕南，一夜与杜邦杰于车内发生争执，怎料汽车失事...

programme.title: 豪侠传
programme.desc: 平西王因与金龙山强盗结仇，女儿被掳走他非常焦急，请剑侠岳震北帮忙，岳估计一人之力不够，幸得多位武功高强的好友相助一同去金龙山破盗寨各人步步小心，希望能成功救人

programme.title: 猎人
programme.desc: 花花公子周国雄有一本猎人日记专门去记录他四出猎艳的故事，周丢弃刘明华，又去追猎吕绮美，刘突然遭人杀死后来周又去追求女学生朱丽珍...但当晚，吕遭杀死，警方向周追查同时周想到和他亲近的女人，一个一个的被杀死，嫌凶渐指向他，好像有人在陷害自己周开始追查真相

programme.title: 洪拳与咏春
programme.desc: 清廷派人扫平少林寺，杀掉所有少林弟子从中幸存出来的两名弟子，分别拜入咏春及洪拳师傅门下，学习拳法最终他们挟技击败敌人，并为死去师兄弟报仇

programme.title: 野姑娘
programme.desc: 金小芳是一位活泼且无畏的乡村少女，面对恶霸从不退缩，总是勇敢反抗当她揭露了唐家大少爷的阴谋后，立刻引来他的狠毒报复幸好，她心仪的男子大海及时挺身而出相救两人能否携手对抗险恶命运，改写结局？

programme.title: 裸血
programme.desc: 凌波的丈夫高远及其友王侠，均与肚皮舞女郎孟莉有染，孟借此勒索二人；后孟被杀，高成嫌疑犯，另孟之兄翟诺，亦向高勒索；而凌在家，也接见了谷峰，他声言有为高洗罪的证据，但要索钱；王妻李香君借贷给凌... 究竟谁是杀孟真凶？

programme.title: 玉女嬉春
programme.desc: 吕紫英陪同父吕天奇到台湾发展，两姐白虹青萍留港继续歌舞生涯白虹认识江庆良后投契相恋，江向老板引荐白虹在歌剧中当主角，老父回来见三位女儿成就，开心不已

programme.title: 勾魂降头
programme.desc: 青年医生时振声在医院中发现很多奇难杂症，无法以医学理论解释，遂请好友齐中平夫妇共同研究几经追查，才发现那些病人均是中了降头原来施降者是精通邪术，以爱情降头协助富商追求梦中情人，博取巨额报酬中平不信妖邪之说，其妻子更不惜以身相试，更被施以死降，如果无法破解，二十四小时后便会身亡...

programme.title: 教头
programme.desc: 河东府教头王阳受地方土绅孟二达陷害，成杀人疑犯，惟匿藏孟家任教头后王收好武青年周平为徒，却惹孟不满；原来周孟两大族为死敌，孟觉聘王当教头，实乃养虎为患，遂唆使大盗一条鞭施以偷袭，幸王逃过大难，只是受了伤孟家有寄居少女嘉嘉向不值孟氏所为，且对王很有好感，遂暗中援手...

programme.title: 铁扇公主
programme.desc: 唐僧师徒西行取经，受阻于烈火绵延的火焰山，唯有铁扇公主的芭蕉扇方能灭火然而因红孩儿一事，牛魔王夫妇拒不相助孙悟空遂与二人展开三调芭蕉扇的智勇较量越过火焰山后，师徒不幸落入白骨精姐妹设下的长生圈套面对诡计多端的妖精，悟空再施神通，护师脱险

programme.title: 血手印
programme.desc: 穷书生林肇德与富翁女儿订亲，但富翁因其家道中落而反对婚事为迎娶挚爱，肇德上京考取功名，临行前会晤未婚妻，怎料却碰上婢女满身鲜血伏尸后花园因不慎留下血手印于门上，他更被诬陷杀人直至包公及时重审，为他洗脱冤情

programme.title: 保镖
programme.desc: 洛阳无敌庄庄主失去了所有功力，于是请来侄儿与未婚妻一起护送黄金前往京城在途中，他们遇到了一名神秘侠客，三人随即联手对抗盗匪，竭力保护黄金不被劫走

programme.title: 少林传人
programme.desc: 九王爷谋朝篡位，率领奸臣叛贼攻入皇宫；皇帝见大势已去，命两名忠心侍卫各抱一名太子突围而出辗转之下，大太子由少林戒律院三僧抚养，法号道行，习得少林绝技；二太子则易名五子泰，由丞相抚养多年后，五子泰前往少林寺借阅易筋经，与道行相遇，却不知对方正是亲兄弟......

programme.title: 十二金钱镖
programme.desc: 乔茂押镖时，遇女贼袁玉蓉，举刀要杀之际，却被袁的美丽媚态吸引，后两人互生爱慕，更发现凭独门武器十二金钱镖名震天下的俞剑平，与背后操控袁的老头，有段血海深仇...

programme.title: 云泥
programme.desc: 女主角熊素素因不能接受机师男友意外身亡而患上精神分裂症，一天巧遇留学归来的精神科医生黎易非，多次奇幻的相遇令易非和素素卷入三角恋和复杂的内心纠结之中

programme.title: 单程路
programme.desc: 李修贤是一摩托车行东主，曾是著名车手，惟一次意外中伤残；他对学徒麦德罗甚为赏识，麦因李之启蒙而在澳门赛车中夺标李闻悉麦参与非法赛车，予以规劝，惟麦受盛名之累，欲罢不能...

programme.title: 魂断奈何天
programme.desc: 良才见秋容貌美，心怀不轨，竟将其迷奸秋容醒来后为良才甜言蜜意所惑，相信他禀明父母后会娶她为妻谁知数月后，良才音讯全无，秋容更发现自已怀有身孕，于是马上去找良才可惜那时秋容才发现良才已另娶名门闺秀为妻，更打算将秋容灭口...

programme.title: 七煞
programme.desc: 由七位坛主控制的七煞会，在江湖上掀起腥风血雨, 人人闻风丧胆朝廷特派刑部尚书杨宇统筹剿灭，并派卧底从内瓦解组织，随着七煞会内冲突不断升温，幕后坛主可会找出卧底？

programme.title: 花心大少

programme.title: 怪谈

programme.title: 逆战

programme.desc: 满清年间，聪敏机灵的宋世杰王浩信饰因父亲宋安张达明饰是名狱吏，从小就游走于牢房内，见尽世间不平之事，令他不相信法律有公义世杰长大后亦不愿进官场，纵有真才实学，也只暗中相助同试考生何守信林子聪饰中举，他则偕兄弟宋阿九金刚饰浪游天下世杰及后却被卷进蜘蛛精杀人案中，他为寻真凶展示状师才华，期间更结识了武功高强的青楼护卫玲珑姚子羚饰......案件了结，世杰和玲珑结为夫妻，他亦正式踏上状师之路，还接连遇到一宗宗错综复杂的大案......

programme.title: 法外风云 第11集
programme.desc: 城中两大名嘴律师余英伟黎耀祥和李名扬陈豪在法庭上各施奇谋，针锋相对，英伟反败为胜却差点丧命，令他重新审视人生，他的转变令资深律师卢琛保岳华另眼相看，招揽英伟加盟处理一宗富豪遗产案

programme.title: 法外风云 第12集
programme.desc: 城中两大名嘴律师余英伟黎耀祥和李名扬陈豪在法庭上各施奇谋，针锋相对，英伟反败为胜却差点丧命，令他重新审视人生，他的转变令资深律师卢琛保岳华另眼相看，招揽英伟加盟处理一宗富豪遗产案

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白 第18集
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 天涯侠医 第6集
programme.desc: 王甫芬医生张家辉为完成女友彤梁咏琪的遗愿而加入国际救援组织生命动力，其后更成立以平民为对象的龙城医疗中心芬随组织在肯尼亚工作时，认识了年轻的齐百恒林峰医生原本在私家医院凌霄医院任职的恒其后亦受芬影响而加入龙城芬以病人为先的精神不但感染了恒，亦叫在凌霄当护士的康乔郭羡妮心仪，可惜芬始终忘不了彤另方面，恒在非洲认识了义工夏晓晴唐宁，对她留下了深刻的印象；其后二人再在龙城相遇，惟晴却因恒身边的富家女高小柔陈敏之而却步恒跟随芬在龙城及生命动力工作，明白到医生除了医病亦能帮助病人活出生命的意义可能医者真的不能自医，助人无数的恒和芬在面对自己的人生挑战时，也有无助的时候......

programme.title: 香港人在北京 第14集
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁陈展鹏饰藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦吴若希饰误堕投资骗局，损失惨重港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲蔡洁饰，婚姻面临考验美食网红徐港文洪永城饰街头歌手徐宝怡戴祖仪饰各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园佛系主义的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传 第16集
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子

programme.title: 跳跃生命线 第19集
programme.desc: 妻子章蕙芯李佳芯饰死于一宗司机醉驾事故后，救护总队目麦在田马德钟饰跟独女诺儿姐姐爱花张文慈饰小姨章可祈刘佩钥饰共同生活在田因丧妻一事痛恨不守规矩任意妄为的人和事，公事上铁面无私！新下属卓家杰何广沛饰为人冲动，与在田常生磨擦此外，调任见习救护主任的上级谭家俊罗天宇饰凡事追求完美，更处处针对家杰，令队员压力大增；在田作为中间桥梁，苦心经营，力求维系队员的团结及合作精神，同时希望培育出色的救护精英，在不同个案挑战中，抢救更多宝贵的生命......

programme.desc: 王甫芬医生张家辉为完成女友彤梁咏琪的遗愿而加入国际救援组织生命动力，其后更成立以平民为对象的龙城医疗中心芬随组织在肯尼亚工作时，认识了年轻的齐百恒林峰医生原本在私家医院凌霄医院任职的恒其后亦受芬影响而加入龙城芬以病人为先的精神不但感染了恒，亦叫在凌霄当护士的康乔郭羡妮心仪，可惜芬始终忘不了彤另方面，恒在非洲认识了义工夏晓晴唐宁，对她留下了深刻的印象；其后二人再在龙城相遇，惟晴却因恒身边的富家女高小柔陈敏之而却步恒跟随芬在龙城及生命动力工作，明白到医生除了医病亦能帮助病人活出生命的意义可能医者真的不能自医，助人无数的恒和芬在面对自己的人生挑战时，也有无助的时候......

programme.title: 香港人在北京 第14集
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁陈展鹏饰藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦吴若希饰误堕投资骗局，损失惨重港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲蔡洁饰，婚姻面临考验美食网红徐港文洪永城饰街头歌手徐宝怡戴祖仪饰各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园佛系主义的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传 第16集
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子

programme.title: 跳跃生命线 第19集
programme.desc: 妻子章蕙芯李佳芯饰死于一宗司机醉驾事故后，救护总队目麦在田马德钟饰跟独女诺儿姐姐爱花张文慈饰小姨章可祈刘佩钥饰共同生活在田因丧妻一事痛恨不守规矩任意妄为的人和事，公事上铁面无私！新下属卓家杰何广沛饰为人冲动，与在田常生磨擦此外，调任见习救护主任的上级谭家俊罗天宇饰凡事追求完美，更处处针对家杰，令队员压力大增；在田作为中间桥梁，苦心经营，力求维系队员的团结及合作精神，同时希望培育出色的救护精英，在不同个案挑战中，抢救更多宝贵的生命......

ALL ABOUT CHINA! 지금까지 당신이 알고 있던 중국은 잊어라! 중국과 한국의 명사들에게 듣는 중국인도 모르는 중국의 진짜 이야기! quot표절 천국이냐 한류를 넘어선 콘텐츠 강국이냐, 대륙의 문화 콘텐츠의 민낯은? 슈퍼 차이나인가 차이나쇼크인가? 미래의 차이나 리포트는?quot 당신이 모르던 진짜 중국에 대한 이야기를 들려준다. 한중 대표 지식인 6인의 버라이어티 강연쇼! 같은 주제에 다른 시각 또는 각자의 관점으로 이야기 하라! 신중한 강연쇼는 통찰력으로 무장한 한국과 중국의 지성 교양인 6인이 출연하여 매회 한국 대툐와 중국 대표 강연자가 한가지 테마를 두고 강연을 펼친다. 다양한 테마는 기본, 한중 양국의 다채로운 시선과 생각을 공유할 수 있는 새로운 형식의 버라이어티 강연쇼로 시청자들에게 다가갈 수 있을 것이다.

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.desc: 本集的主角, 是十七歲少年哈里森和他的1963年雪佛蘭新星；這輛車是數年前他以自己打工賺的錢購買, 想和父親一同整修的舊車, 但父親不幸遭酒醉駕駛撞死後, 哈里森完全失去整修的慾望, 車閒置在車庫裡好多年母親和好友為了替哈里森止痛療傷, 因此報名將車交由奇普和改造大隊進行為期七天的變身大改造奇普為哈里森設計了銀藍三色車身, 並安排氣程科技提供可讓車身上升下降的氣囊式懸吊系統, 加上傅斯版的全套音響設備, 艾德布魯克引擎廠提供的363匹馬力閃亮組裝引擎, 卡茲金內裝廠製作的全新內裝和桶狀前座椅, 外加新增的中控台和排檔桿哈里森看到愛車變得煥然一新, 除了記起和父親在一起共度的時光, 也感謝媽媽和好友的貼心

programme.title: 浩克慢遊
programme.desc: 天很藍，世界很大我揹上背包，迎著陽光，享受寧靜五月，稻田由翠青轉為墨綠眼前的這熟悉景致，許久以來，和我們的生活緊密相連農人穿梭田中，白黃色汗衫在大片的綠中，格外明顯上學的小學生急忙跑過旁邊的小徑，差點撞上沾滿泥土的老野狼再仔細觀看，雲的流動，讓陽光在田中染上不同層次的綠，稻浪不規則的轉換樹枝的擺動落葉的方向，讓我看見風心要夠靜，旅行的況味才得以擴展開來童年的旅行叫遠足，關注的是書包得裝滿平日難得吃到的零食，至於去哪裡倒不是那麼重要年輕時的旅行，拚的是疾走的氣勢，一路騎車到墾丁，早上吃完包子，還可以在沙灘上奔跑一整天現在的旅行，我會放慢腳步，聆聽不期而遇的滿滿人情台灣的美，絕對處處充滿驚喜
